title: Ambrosial British Mincemeat Tart
description: A sweet, tender tart featuring a rich mincemeat filling cooked sous-vide for perfect texture, topped with glossy butter and baked to golden perfection.
instructions: Combine flour, cold butter, 5 g salt and 5 g baking powder; pulse in mixer until coarse crumbs.
Add egg and cold water; mix until dough forms; roll onto floured surface; cut into circles to fit tart shells.
Line shallow tart pans with pastry; prick bottom with fork.
Mix mincemeat with brandy, cinnamon, nutmeg, vanilla and melted butter; seal mixture in a vacuum bag.
Cook vacuum-sealed mincemeat sous-vide at 60°C for 45 minutes; then chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Spoon chilled mincemeat into pastry shells; spoon melted butter over top.
Bake for 25 minutes until pastry golden; let cool 10 minutes before serving.
